content.text:
upload_dir: /data/upload


# logging.config.dictConfig
logging:
  version: 1
  disable_existing_loggers: false
  log_dir: /data/logs
  formatters:
    simple:
      format: '%(asctime)s:%(levelname)s:%(name)s:%(funcName)s:%(lineno)d:%(message)s'
  handlers:
    stdout:
      class: logging.StreamHandler
      formatter: simple
      stream: ext://sys.stdout
  root:
    handlers:
    - stdout
    level: DEBUG
  loggers:
    websockets.client:
      handlers:
        - stdout
      level: INFO
      propagate: false


server:
  host: 0.0.0.0
  port: 8090

database:
  conn_str: 'sqlite:////data/asr-service.db'

message_queue:
  name: asr
  host: redis
  port: 6379


jobs:
  worker: 2

language_detector:
  fallback: de
  probability: 0.65
  supported:
    - de
    - fr
    - en

model_settings:
  default:
    align:
      align_model: null
      interpolate_method: nearest
      no_align: false
      return_char_alignments: null
    align_model: null
